snippet.title: Plumber 3 // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/1738850

The Plumber 3 is a popular logical game, whose goal is to connect two water points in a short time to drain the water. This game has 30 levels with a gradually increasing degree of complexity, and the game is ideally suited for mobile devices.

Developed by
anyfreegame
